paragraphs: The M4 CSL is the most focused variant of the G82-generation M4 — a limited-run, lightweight, track-oriented model that sits above the standard M4 and M4 Competition. Powering the M4 CSL is the S58 — a 3.0-litre twin-turbo inline-six that also underpins the G82 M4 Competition and G87 M2. The S58 is a genuine reliability improvement over the previous-generation S55: its closed-deck block design and revised architecture have proven robust in real-world use, and the crank hub issue that affected the earlier engine hasn't carried over to this application. This is a low-volume, high-performance variant, and we treat every S58 rebuild with the same precision as the factory intended.
about.boldParagraph: The M4 CSL is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
